items.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE premium landscape concept board showing exactly THREE evolving versions of ONE collectible figurine for CLUTCH esports prediction app. Dark graphite studio backdrop with soft warm showcase spotlights, high fidelity painted resin miniature photography look. Three equal columns, each complete full-body figurine on identical simple round charcoal plinth, front three-quarter pose, generous margins and no clipping. Their family resemblance must be unmistakable, visibly increasing detail and maturity from left to right. Main French title 'BRUMOUSSE — ÉVOLUTION'. Small CLUTCH wordmark. Labels beneath plinths exactly '01 · ORIGINE', '02 · ÉVEIL', '03 · BRUMOUSSE ANCESTRAL'. Subtle thin arrows between columns at plinth height. Character directions: Small round cream-furred woodland familiar, huge dark expressive eyes, green leaves forming crown and mantle, small violet crystal buds. Stage 1 tiny compact baby with few leaf sprouts. Stage 2 same recognizable face and body, fuller leafy mantle, violet flowers opening and taller crystal crown. Stage 3 majestic slightly larger mature creature, still charming round recognizable Brumousse, abundant layered foliage, woody shoulder details, softly luminous violet central crystal, elegant small branching crown. No turning into humanoid or dragon. All figures adapted to individual glass showcase slots. Clear real material textures, restrained luminous details, sharp readable silhouette, no interface buttons, no prices, no stats, no progress bars, no extra characters, no dioramas. This is a visual exploration of three collectible forms, not an animation.
